items.headline: EU approves earlier-stage combination therapy for relapsed multiple myeloma
items.summary: The European Commission approved a two drug immune therapy combination, teclistamab and daratumumab, for patients with relapsed multiple myeloma as early as their second line of treatment. A large randomized trial of nearly six hundred patients found the combination outperformed standard treatment.
items.why_it_matters: It gives blood cancer patients earlier access to a more effective, targeted immune treatment instead of waiting until later, harder to treat relapses.
